paragraphs.text: On a free afternoon, the notes for a task you know well can start turning into an outline. With Saturn squaring your natal Sun, though, the task itself can take more effort than usual, and if it fills the whole afternoon, the next piece needs hours that are already spoken for. This is the second of three calculated contacts; the first exact contact falls in September 2026.
